T1.implementation_approach: Create a clean and intuitive UI using a frontend framework like React, ensuring easy navigation and search functionality.
T1.notes: Focus on responsive design for different screen sizes.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem data retrieval, creation, and updates using a backend framework like Node.js or Django.
T2.notes: Ensure proper authentication and authorization mechanisms.

T3.implementation_approach: Design a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata using MySQL or PostgreSQL.
T3.notes: Optimize for query performance and scalability.

T4.implementation_approach: Build a user-friendly interface for code submission with syntax highlighting and file upload support.
T4.notes: Integrate with the backend for real-time feedback.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop a backend service to handle code execution and evaluation securely using containerized environments.
T5.notes: Implement timeout and resource usage limits to prevent abuse.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up isolated Docker containers or a sandbox environment to execute user-submitted code safely.
T6.notes: Ensure proper security measures to prevent malicious code execution.

T7.implementation_approach: Design a profile UI to display user details, progress, and achievements using a frontend framework.
T7.notes: Incorporate visual elements like progress bars and badges.

T8.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage user data, including profile updates and progress tracking.
T8.notes: Ensure data consistency and secure storage of sensitive information.

T9.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store user information, progress, and activity logs using a relational or NoSQL database.

T10.implementation_approach: Create a dynamic leaderboard UI to display top users based on various metrics like scores or activity.
T10.notes: Include filters and sorting options for better usability.

T11.implementation_approach: Implement backend logic to calculate and update leaderboard rankings in real-time or at regular intervals.
T11.notes: Optimize for performance with caching mechanisms.

T12.implementation_approach: Design a UI to display hints and explanations for problems, ensuring they are accessible but not intrusive.
T12.notes: Allow users to toggle visibility of hints.

T13.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage hints and explanations, including retrieval and updates.
T13.notes: Ensure hints are tied to specific problems in the database.

T14.implementation_approach: Perform end-to-end testing of the problem library, including UI, backend, and database interactions.
T14.notes: Use automated test cases for consistent validation.

T15.implementation_approach: Test the code submission and evaluation flow, including edge cases and security vulnerabilities.
T15.notes: Simulate various user inputs to ensure robustness.

T16.implementation_approach: Validate user profile functionality, including progress tracking and data updates, through manual and automated tests.
T16.notes: Check for data consistency across the system.

T17.implementation_approach: Test the leaderboard functionality for accuracy, performance, and real-time updates.
T17.notes: Verify sorting and filtering options work as expected.

T18.implementation_approach: Test the hints and explanations feature for proper integration with the UI and backend.
T18.notes: Ensure hints are displayed correctly and tied to the right problems.
